reviews.review_title: This is a really good game.
reviews.review_description: Now this game is a really good game the perfect gorilla tag fan game but they’re just one thing maybe even two I would like it if you could bring the gun that you bought in the dino hunt mini game and then bring it into the zombie wave or just bring it into the levels to at least save you from getting demolished. I would like it if the jungle will be massive full of dinosaurs, but it could be stretched alone as a long open valley where you have a lot of guns to choose from you get daily Dino bucks or as I like to say it, Dino Nuggets to buy weapons each time you get an egg or each time you hunt a dinosaur or even each time you get a zombie wave you should at least get 200 Dino nuggets but when I did that it gave me nothing. Are you able to make the open valley where you’re able to hunt dinosaurs with snipers guns and even Malay weapons you could go all around in a team people could also be dinosaurs in the valley trying to kill you too. I have high hopes for this game perfect game thank you for making this my dream never give up.
